name: btoon/btoon
description: BTOON for PHP: canonical, MessagePack-compatible binary serialization with columnar tables (pure PHP)

suggest.ext-gmp: Faster BTOON\BigInt conversions and GMP interop
suggest.ext-mbstring: Faster UTF-8 validation (falls back to PCRE)
suggest.ext-lz4: LZ4 compression envelopes (kjdev/php-ext-lz4 >= 0.8, raw block API)

scripts.sync-vectors: @php -r "\$src = (getenv('BTOON_CORE') ?: '../btoon-core') . '/tests/vectors/btoon-vectors.json'; if (!is_file(\$src) || !copy(\$src, 'tests/vectors/btoon-vectors.json')) { fwrite(STDERR, 'cannot copy ' . \$src . PHP_EOL); exit(1); } echo 'copied ', \$src, PHP_EOL;"

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite (unit tests + conformance vectors)
scripts-descriptions.sync-vectors: Copy the conformance vectors from btoon-core (override the path with BTOON_CORE=/path/to/btoon-core)
